draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.10, the 119th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 7th of 21 at S. He went 65th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (119th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 11 tackles in 2020, 21st of 21 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 71 career games and 55 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2022. Weak spots: interceptions 0 (22nd percentile), passes defended 1 (22nd percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 safety who played: 44.2% season snap share against a median of 59.9%, below the norm.
